slides.h: WE DON'T NAME OUR [[SOURCES]]. ON PURPOSE.
slides.dek: The most common question in our DMs, answered honestly.

slides.h: WHERE DO THE NUMBERS COME FROM?
body: Every receipt we post says things like 'search interest' or 'marketplace bestseller data'. Vague on purpose.
The sources are real and public. The rules for republishing their data are strict, and we read them before we post.

items: **No brand names for clout.** A famous platform's name in a headline gets reach. We genericize it instead.
**Posts die in review.** If a chart can't be shared under a source's terms, it never leaves the drafts folder.
**Slower posting.** Every number gets a can-we-defend-this check before it gets a design.

body: Accounts that repost data they have no right to use collect takedowns, strikes, and one day a blank grid.
We would rather grow slower and still be here next Diwali.

slides.q: IF WE CAN'T DEFEND A NUMBER, [[YOU DON'T SEE IT.]]

slides.h: ASK US ANYTHING. WE'LL TELL YOU WHAT WE CAN.
slides.body: Building an honest data account in public, rules and all.
